final_text:
I’ve visited both sites and have some initial thoughts:

**Dora’s website (www.dora-website.com)**  
- Clean, minimal design with easy navigation.  
- The page simply states it’s her personal site and provides her e‑mail (dora@gmail.com).  
- **Suggestions:** Add a brief “About” section (e.g., background, skills, projects), showcase any work or portfolio items, and include additional contact options (contact form, LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.). Also double‑check mobile responsiveness.

**Eve’s blog (www.eve-blog.com)**  
- Very concise: “This is the blog of Eve. My favorite hobby is hiking.”  
- No
